Subject: Mutual Action Plan kickoff: marketplace listing + evaluation (Acme Health / AWS & GCP)

Hi Ami / Laura —

Thanks again for the productive discovery last week. Per our conversation, I wanted to kick off a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to align stakeholders, milestones, and responsibilities for Acme Health's evaluation and subsequent cloud marketplace listing on AWS (primary) and GCP (secondary).

High-level goal:
- Get Acme Health through a technical evaluation and procurement sign-off, and complete an AWS Marketplace SaaS listing by mid-Jan 2027, with GCP listing to follow in Q1.

Suggested initial milestones (draft):
1) Security & compliance evidence collection — target: 2026-12-15
2) Technical evaluation & integration runbook review — target: 2026-12-22
3) Procurement & commercial review (MSA/PO) — target: 2027-01-05
4) AWS Marketplace listing submission & validation — target: 2027-01-20

Roles / owners (draft):
- Acme Health exec sponsor: Ami Shah (evaluation sign-off, procurement lead)
- Acme technical lead: (please confirm)
- Redwood marketplace lead: Vanessa Ortiz (listing ops)
- Redwood partner ops / AWS coordination: Sergio Alvarez
- Redwood seller / deal lead: Ben Carter (me)

Immediate asks:
- Ami: confirm technical lead and procurement contact (I see procurement@acmehealth.com on copy; please confirm the name)
- Laura / AWS team: confirm any pre-checks needed on your side (IAM, listing format, legal templates) — I’ve pulled in Sergio for ops details
- All: please confirm availability for a 30-minute kickoff call next week. I’m proposing:
   * Tue 2026-12-07 10:00 PST / 13:00 EST (Google Meet)
   * Wed 2026-12-08 09:00 PST as an alternate

Attached: draft MAP spreadsheet (v1) and a short technical checklist for marketplace submissions. I’ll circulate a v2 after we lock attendees and dates.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Hi all — Rajiv from AWS Partner Ops here, adding myself for the marketplace sequence. Appreciate the MAP outline. A couple quick items from the AWS listing side:

1) Precheck: please share the SaaS integration pattern (SaaS subscription or AMI + metering) and the expected customer provisioning flow. If you have a short diagram, attach it.
2) Legal: we can provide the standard AWS listing templates; I’ll need the Redwood legal contact to exchange terms.
3) Technical validation: I can reserve a slot with our listing validation team the week of Jan 10 — we’ll need the listing artifacts by 01/03 to get that window.

I’m attaching a short precheck for AWS listings (AWS_listing_precheck.pdf) — it calls out the common blockers (IAM roles, billing contract, marketplace product SKU).

Happy to join the kickoff Tuesday at 10:00 PST.

—Rajiv Menon
